title: Netflix Announces New UK Commissions at Edinburgh TV Festival
summary: Netflix has unveiled its most wide ranging slate of new commissions to date, from shows that will get the whole country talking, to the most innovative content creator formats and cult fandoms that keep audiences coming back.
body_markdown:
Netflix has unveiled its most wide-ranging slate of new commissions to date, from shows that will get the whole country talking, to the most innovative content creator formats and cult fandoms that keep audiences coming back.


The new slate sees


Kate Winslet,


Clive Owen


and


Barry Keoghan


join a stellar drama line up alongside


Maxine Peak


,


Anya Taylor Joy


and


Imelda Staunton


; brand new comedy from beloved writers


Robert Popper


(


Friday Night Dinner


) and


Lisa McGee


(


Derry Girls


);


Luke Littler


joining forces with


Gary Lineker


to lead the charge in live sports action, and


The Sidemen


bringing their latest venture to Netflix.


> Anne Mensah, Vice President, UK Content, said:
>
>
> “In the amazingly competitive UK landscape, it’s not good enough to be just ok. You need to swing for exceptional. Across drama, comedy, entertainment, live and factual programming, our slate underscores the risks we are happy to take and the extraordinary UK creativity we are proud to champion. Bring on 2027, we can’t wait.”


-


THE UNHEARD


:


Tells the story of two sisters (Kate Winslet & Maxine Peake) who go on the run after an act of vengeance goes wrong. This is a brand new television drama from director Mounia Akl and writer Jack Thorne, from Warp Films, Matriarch and Plan B.


-


BEAT LUKE LITTLER


:


Gary Lineker will join as host and Richard Osman as expert analyst on this high-stakes live darts event that pits ambitious amateurs against the world number one: all for a chance to win £501,000. The groundbreaking live special will see 20 competitors from across the nation and beyond step up to the oche for the ultimate sporting challenge.


-


HOW TO KILL YOUR FAMILY


\[CASTING\]:


Clive Owen, Orlando Norman and David Shields join Anya Taylor Joy in the series based on Bella Mackie’s bestselling novel.


-


JONNY BOY


:


Five-episode series from the world of


Top Boy


with Barry Keoghan reprising his role as Jonny. Written and created by Ronan Bennett.


-


JAQ


:


From the world of


Top Boy


a new series centered on the character of Jaq with Jasmine Jobson set to return. Created and written by Ryan Calais Cameron. Based on the series


Top Boy


created by Ronan Bennett


-


JIG


:


A brand new comedy series from


Derry Girls


Creator Lisa McGee.


Jig


, a new six-part mockumentary set in the high-stakes world of competitive Irish dancing, will shoot in Northern Ireland next year. Commissioned for Netflix from Orchid Pictures


-


MARBLES:


A new family comedy from Robert Popper (


Friday Night Dinner


) starring Robert Webb, Timothy Spall, Alexandra Roach, Denise Welch and Loo Brealey.


-


OUTSIDE:


Outside


is the latest spin-off from the Sidemen's smash-hit series


Inside


. A new group of content creators are thrown into the forest to battle for a prize of up to £1 million.


-


UNTITLED DAHL STORIES FOR ADULTS


:


The six-part series starring Naomi Scott, Josh Finan, Imelda Staunton, Nicola Coughlan, Toby Jones and Dominic West. The series is based on a collection of Roald Dahl's short stories for adults which goes into production this month in Manchester and across the North of England.
